name: Takayashiki Hiroshi
source: A large, middle-aged man, strong enough to defend against 5 Chinese as well as general handyman and a man of many talents. Lost sanity when his wife divorced him and his family disowned him due to debts. He proposes the "family project" and takes on the Father role.
